description:
Weekly behavioral telemetry aggregated from LMS logs, video player events,
and assignment submissions.
Transmitted from LMS to Component 2 (Behavioral Engagement Trajectory).

avg_submission_delay_hours.description: Average hours relative to deadline. Negative value indicates early submission (e.g. -4.5 = 4.5 hours early); positive value indicates late submission.
avg_submission_delay_hours.title: Avg Submission Delay Hours

login_count.description: Total distinct logins/sessions started during the week
login_count.title: Login Count

session_minutes.description: Total active time spent on the platform in minutes
session_minutes.title: Session Minutes

submissions_count.description: Number of assignments or lab tasks submitted during the week
submissions_count.title: Submissions Count

video_completion_pct.description: Average video completion percentage across assigned lectures (0.0 to 100.0)
video_completion_pct.title: Video Completion Pct

video_pause_count.description: Number of video pause events triggered
video_pause_count.title: Video Pause Count

video_play_count.description: Number of video play events triggered
video_play_count.title: Video Play Count

video_rewind_count.description: Number of backward seek / rewind events (indicator of difficulty)
video_rewind_count.title: Video Rewind Count

video_skip_count.description: Number of forward seek / skip events
video_skip_count.title: Video Skip Count

title: BehaviorWeeklyRecord
